# Bounce — account brief

## Who

Bounce runs a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world ([source](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Bounce at usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `usebounce/bounce-app` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo lists react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 14 public repos and 96 followers ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).
- `usebounce/bounce-app` last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)).
- The App Store listing has 12,800 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- There were 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- Bounce links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://usebounce.com/careers)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@usebounce-maintainer-1), 118 commits, top contributor to `usebounce/bounce-app` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Bounce", location "Remote", website https://usebounce.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Bounce. Maintains the Bounce app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@usebounce-maintainer-2), 64 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Bounce", location "New York, NY", website https://usebounce.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Bounce mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Bounce app." ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@usebounce-maintainer-3), 22 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Bounce", location "San Francisco, CA", website https://usebounce.com, and bio "Engineer at Bounce. Mostly the Bounce app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

`usebounce/bounce-app` last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Bounce app on Expo / React Native ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)), and you have 118 commits to `usebounce/bounce-app` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). The repo has an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside its own CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). Across those 5 releases, where does the handoff between your GitHub workflows and EAS cost you the most time?
